data.title: Meta’s Muse Glimmer Courts Users As Big Tech And Governments Shape AI
data.description: Meta’s Muse Glimmer courts users with local AI control, challenging institutional power. As the debate heats up, controllable on-device AI may become more prevalent.
data.author: Luis E. Romero
data.keywords: Meta,Muse Glimmer,Mark Zuckerberg,AI,superintelligence,Meta's Manifesto,The Future Is for Everyone
